body:
Priya: quick pulse — we saw a concentrated spike in errors for 3 mid-market accounts this week, want to share a short breakdown and proposed actions
Aisha: thanks. high-level numbers?
Priya: overall error composition (72h rolling): 5xx = 62%, timeouts = 25%, rate-limits = 13%
Aisha: can you paste the top failing endpoints and counts? need to surface to AMs
Priya: sure — top endpoints by error count (last 72h):
```
/v1/generate                      2,740 errors  (mainly 502/503)
/v1/chat/stream                   1,210 timeouts
/v1/embeddings                   640 429/rate-limit bursts
/rpc/predict                      310 5xx (OOM on dedicated nodes)
/status/health-check              120 sporadic 5xx (downstream timeout)
```
Priya: affected accounts: AcmeCorp (v-high traffic), BrightScale (sporadic bursts), Novapay (steady small batch failures)
Sam: looking at infra traces — majority of `/v1/generate` 5xx map to one model worker pool that hit a kernel fallback on quantized models; backend logs show repeated `CUDA out of memory` then 502s
Lars: embeddings rate-limit spikes line up with a client that changed to parallelized batching last week — likely hitting per-customer concurrency caps
Aisha: ok. immediate asks: 1) mitigate customer-facing errors this week 2) owners + ETA for root-cause tasks 3) AM notes for renewals/risks
Sam: immediate mitigation: we can enable automatic fallback to smaller batch mode for the problematic worker pool (config flip). I can do a canary today for AcmeCorp only. ETA 2h to deploy and monitor
Priya: thanks Sam — assign Sam to canary for AcmeCorp. Sam, please post results in this thread
Sam: will do. also opening ticket ENG-8719 for OOM root cause, linking traces and kernel logs
Priya: for BrightScale rate-limit — recommend outreach to suggest client reduce parallel batch concurrency or we can raise soft quota while engineering monitors. Owner: Aisha to coordinate AM outreach
Aisha: noted — will message BrightScale + include short mitigation steps and ask for traffic pattern snapshot. will flag renewal touchpoint if errors persist
Lars: long-term fixes: 1) better per-customer adaptive throttling 2) tune quantized kernels for that model family 3) autoscaler policy tweak to avoid hitting small-pool OOMs
Priya: assigning long-term owners: Lars + Sam to investigate kernel/quantization; timeline: initial findings by next Wed (2028-01-11)
Priya: copying deploy-bot alert for visibility
deploy-bot: [alert] 1789000750: spike detected — 5xx rate up 4.8x on /v1/generate. Link: https://observability.internal/alerts/1789000750
Aisha: AM notes: AcmeCorp — medium risk if errors continue, offer temporary quota bump + discounted support check-in. BrightScale — low risk with outreach. Novapay — monitor after canary
Priya: next steps summary:
- Sam: canary flip for AcmeCorp in 2h, report back here (owner: Sam)
- Sam + Lars: root cause ticket ENG-8719, initial triage by next Wed (owner: Lars/Sam)
- Aisha: BrightScale outreach + pattern request today (owner: Aisha)
- Priya: update AM notes and include in weekly sync (owner: Priya)
Aisha: thanks — pls ping if canary shows regressions. closing loop: follow-up thread scheduled for next Tue check-in
Sam: canary started, posting initial metrics in 30m
Priya: appreciated — if anyone wants me to loop legal/compliance for Private customers, call it out now
Aisha: not needed yet
Priya: ok — will keep this thread for updates only
